scripts.routine:status: launchctl list | grep -F ai.opencode.routine || echo 'not loaded -- run: pnpm routine:start'
scripts.routine:start: launchctl bootstrap gui/$(id -u) "$HOME/Library/LaunchAgents/ai.opencode.routine.plist" 2>/dev/null; launchctl list | grep -qF ai.opencode.routine && echo 'routine loaded -- runs hourly' || echo 'failed to load -- check ~/Library/LaunchAgents/ai.opencode.routine.plist'
scripts.routine:stop: launchctl bootout gui/$(id -u)/ai.opencode.routine 2>/dev/null; launchctl list | grep -qF ai.opencode.routine && echo 'still loaded -- stop failed' || echo 'routine unloaded'
scripts.routine:run: launchctl kickstart -p gui/$(id -u)/ai.opencode.routine && echo 'routine triggered -- follow with: pnpm routine:logs'
